_comment: Local-development OIDC realm for the LiveCore full local stack (CORE-DEP-006). Imported by Keycloak with --import-realm so the api validates real bearer tokens. Product-neutral (AGENTS.md); contains only well-known LOCAL credentials, never a production secret (threat T7). Harden or replace before exposing anywhere — see deploy/compose/README.md.

clients._comment: The API resource. Its clientId is the token audience the api validates (Authentication__Oidc__Audience=livecore-api). Bearer-only: it never initiates a login, it only consumes tokens.

A public client a vertical app uses to obtain tokens for the api. Direct access grants are enabled so a local developer can mint a token with the demo user (password grant); the audience mapper adds livecore-api to the token so the api accepts it.

protocolMappers.name: organization-claim
protocolMappers._comment: A starter tenant claim so a token carries the organization the api resolves to a Workspace tenant. Replace the value with a slug that matches an Organization you create through the api.

users._comment: A local demo user for password-grant token testing. Local-only credentials.
